text_block_list.text:
With the Tenno Sho (Spring), the goal she had worked toward,
looming just ahead—

On the day of Valentine's,
Mejiro McQueen called me out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Happy Valentine's Day...
Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Here you are...
Please accept this."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No... It's just that these chocolates are so popular,
there's a six-month waiting list to order them—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you will enjoy it as well,
Trainer...

For some reason, Mejiro McQueen seemed to lack her usual spirit.
I wondered what was wrong.

Chocolate, something sweet... When I think of that...
—Oh, I know!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Eeeh...!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I-I am quite alright, please do not mind me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I'll admit I'm a little—just a tiny bit—curious, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, my long-cherished dream, the Tenno Sho (Spring),
is right around the corner... so please...!"
"It's true that with the Tenno Sho (Spring) right around the corner, gaining weight is the last thing I want to do..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Wh-What do you
have to apologize for...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Please don't mind me at all,
and enjoy it to your heart's content!"

Feeling conscious of Mejiro McQueen's gaze,
I decided to take it home and eat it there.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, my long-cherished dream, the Tenno Sho (Spring),
is right around the corner... so please...!"
"It's true that with the Tenno Sho (Spring) right around the corner, gaining weight is something I'd like to avoid, but—"

One a day should be fine, I'm sure!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? One a day?
Well, in that case...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, Trainer!
Why must you spoil me so?!
choice_data_list: Since you like sweets and all

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Don't look at me with such honest eyes...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Geez, I understand now!
It is my defeat!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I shall gratefully take you up on your offer then, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Honestly, you're always so full of smooth talk.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Still, I get to enjoy those popular chocolates as well, don't I? Fufu♪
